event.chunk: This is a bounded UI transcript test in this disposable directory. First say Checking the sample. Read sample.txt, run a shell command that prints a short numbered list, create result.txt containing the three sample lines in reverse order, and run a check of that file. Then run one harmless command that exits 7 to exercise tool error display. Explain that expected failure and give a final Markdown table of the original and reversed first lines. Keep all prose under 120 words. Do not delegate, use the network, or touch any other directory.

update.title: echo intentional failure for tool display; exit 7

rawInput.command: sh -c 'echo intentional failure for tool display; exit 7'
